data.title: Velora
data.about:
Following the successful launch of The Valley Phase 1, Emaar Properties is proud to introduce Velora at The Valley. This iconic townhouse cluster draws its inspiration from the breathtaking beauty of nature and the thrill of adventure. Velora at The Valley features rolling hills, lush meadows, tranquil rivers, picturesque valleys, and dense forests. As part of Emaar’s flagship mega-development, The Valley Dubai, Velora at The Valley is conveniently located off Dubai-Al Ain Road and aims to set a benchmark for communities focused on nature, adventure, and quality living.

Velora at The Valley offers modern 3 & 4-bedroom townhouses designed with nature in mind, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows. Winding trails weave through these captivating landscapes, inviting explorers to uncover hidden treasures around every corner. Set amidst lush greenery, each home boasts a high-quality finish and picturesque views. Velora at The Valley allows you to be part of an established community with a reputable developer while also providing access to upcoming amenities catered towards an active lifestyle.

With versatile townhouses, you have the opportunity to invest early and watch your property value rise over the years in this desirable neighborhood. Velora at The Valley phase 2 features and amenities offer everything you need for a fulfilling lifestyle.

characteristics_module.title: Connect with Nature at The Valley Phase 2
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Modern 3 & 4 BR Townhouses: Choose from contemporary 3 & 4 BR townhouses in Velora at The Valley by Emaar.
  • Part of an Established Community: Join the thriving community of Velora at The Valley by Emaar.
  • Lush Greenery and Open Spaces: Enjoy the lush landscaping and open spaces in Velora at The Valley in Dubai.
  • Close to Amenities: Access nearby retail areas, sports facilities, and kids' play areas in Velora at The Valley by Emaar.
  • Convenient Location: Velora at The Valley offers easy access to Dubai Al Ain Road.
  • Spacious and Efficient Designs: Live in expansive, efficiently designed homes in Velora at The Valley by Emaar.
  • Largest Plot Sizes: Invest in the largest plots available for townhouses in the market at Velora at The Valley.
  • Secure Investment: Build on the success of The Valley Phase 1 for a safe and secure investment.
  • Flexible Payment Plan: Benefit from a relaxed 80/20 payment plan, paying 20% annually.

location_tile.title: The Ultimate Location at The Valley Phase 2
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Velora at The Valley offers exceptional connectivity via Jebel Ali Lahbab Road, starting at the Sheikh Zayed Road Interchange and extending to Emirates Road. This vital corridor drives rapid development by linking key areas such as Jebel Ali Industrial Area, JAFZA, Dubai South, DIP, and culminating at the Expo 2020 site. The Valley Phase 2 Project by Emaar Properties, situated in the heart of Dubai, is not just a residential area but a thriving community worth investing in. With its picturesque landscapes, premium amenities, and strategic location, living in Velora at The Valley by Emaar offers an unparalleled lifestyle in Dubai.

  • 05 Minutes to Rugby Sevens Stadium
  • 08 Minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 25 Minutes to Burj Khalifa & Dubai Mall
  • 25 Minutes to Dubai Int'l Airport
